text:
elena: Shared recording from today's design review — playback: https://loom/abc123

devon: Saw it. Chunked render is causing layout shift when images/prompts appear. Fade could help but worry about perceived latency. :thinking_face:

rik: Agree. Implemented a CSS crossfade before for notifications. Something like:
```
.message { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); transition: opacity .12s ease, transform .12s ease; }
.message--visible { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
```
Works with streaming sequence; we can stagger by chunk index.

maya: Accessibility note — if user has prefers-reduced-motion, skip the fade and instantly append. Also ensure `aria-live="polite"` for new messages so screenreaders announce them correctly.

elena: Good call. Also need decision on stop/regenerate: current toolbar at top-right is out of reach for keyboard-only. Options:
- inline controls next to message (per-message stop + regen)
- always-visible compact bar with keyboard focus cycles
Which do we prefer for discoverability?

devon: Prefer inline controls for per-response control, but add a persistent hotkey (e.g., `Esc` to stop, `Ctrl+R` to regenerate) and show hint in the token/status bar.

rik: Implementation note — inline controls mean message container should expose `role="group" aria-label="assistant response controls"` and controls must be focusable. We'll need to ensure focus order doesn't jump when messages appear.

maya: Token counter microcopy options (short tests):
- "Tokens: 23 — est $0.0012"
- "23 tokens · ~$0.001"
- "≈23 tokens (cost: $0.0012)"
Which is clearest? Also think about truncating in narrow view.

elena: Leaning toward option 2 for compactness. Add tooltip with exact calc on hover. Also add an accessibility note: provide a screenreader-only string that reads cost in cents.

design-bot: Quick checklist generated from thread: [ ] prefers-reduced-motion handling, [ ] aria-live for replies, [ ] inline controls + hotkey docs, [ ] token microcopy tooltip

rik: For prompt library — UX idea: allow pinning prompts to the top of the library and keyboard shortcuts (number keys to insert). Also add preview toggle (show first 1–2 tokens) so library is scannable.

maya: Copy tweak for prompt pin CTA: "Pin to top" vs "Pin" — prefer shorter but explicit: use "Pin to top". Also microcopy for insert: "Insert prompt" -> keep as "Use" for brevity.

devon: A/B test to try: fade vs instant append (with reduced-motion off). Measure 1) perceived latency (user survey) 2) message read-through (eye-tracking/heatmap) over 1k sessions.

elena: Great. Rik, can you prototype inline controls + fade (respects reduced-motion) by EOD? If not, end of week.

rik: I'll do a small prototype branch. Will call out focus tests in PR.

maya: I'll update the copy doc and add token microcopy variants.

elena: Thanks all — recording + checklist updated. :sparkles:
